items.title: Dr. Bench: A Multidimensional Evaluation for Deep Research Agents, from Answers to Reports
items.description: Yao et al. — https://github.com/EVIGBYEN/DrBench · benchmark — 214 expert-curated deep-research tasks across 10 domains, evaluating long reports for semantic quality, topical focus, and retrieval trustworthiness. 🆕

items.title: 9 · Agent-specific evaluation (trajectories, tool use, multi-turn, world state, multi-agent, localization)

items.description: Must-reads: Dawn Song (BenchJack) · Anthropic (error bars)

items.title: PyRIT — Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI
items.description: Microsoft AI Red Team (Azure) — https://github.com/Azure/PyRIT · tool — The de-facto open-source red-teaming automation framework (70+ converters, multi-turn attacks like Crescendo/TAP); how practitioners actually run adversarial evals at scale. The section lists papers but no tooling. 🆕

repo_info.description: The Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI (PyRIT) is an open source framework built to empower security professionals and engineers to proactively identify risks in generative AI systems.

items.title: AIR-Bench 2024
items.description: Zeng et al. (incl. Song) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.17436v2 · https://github.com/stanford-crfm/air-bench-2024 · paper/repo — Regulation-grounded risk taxonomy.

repo_info.description: AIR-Bench 2024 is a safety benchmark that aligns with emerging government regulations and company policies
